learned.coaster: Energy: a coaster climbs no higher than it started.
learned.gap: A jump is decided the moment your feet leave the ground.
learned.step: A step up needs speed; a vault keeps more of it than a jump.
learned.vault: A vault keeps your speed; a jump spends it.
learned.wall: The wall spends the speed you bring; it cannot add any.
learned.climb: A wall takes your speed; your arms do the rest.
learned.lache: Push with the swing and it grows; push against it and it fades.
learned.rope: A swing gives back the height you fall.
learned.trampoline: The harder you land, the higher it throws you.
learned.drop: Rolling turns a hard fall into forward motion.
learned.launch: Letting go late throws you into the ground.
learned.band: A soft band pulled far stores more energy than a stiff one pulled little.
learned.recoil: Momentum: the light thing goes fast, the heavy thing slow.
learned.cannon: Aim between high and flat: the middle angle flies farthest.
learned.plank: A longer plank bends much more; a thicker one bends less.
learned.drone: A leaning drone has to push harder to stay up.
learned.stack: Speed climbs the cups, and speed carries you off the top.

saying.coaster: A coaster has no engine: it climbs no higher than where it started.
saying.gap: Once your feet leave the ground, the jump is already decided.
saying.wall: The wall can't lift you. It only spends the speed you bring.
saying.rope: Fall to rise: the rope gives back every bit of height you give it.
saying.trampoline: The harder you land, the higher it throws you.
saying.lache: Push with the swing and it grows; push against it and it fades.
saying.vault: A jump buys height with speed; a vault keeps the speed but needs a hand on the obstacle.
saying.climb: Speed gets you to the wall; arms get you over it.
saying.drop: Turn your fall into a roll and the ground forgives you.
saying.launch: A long arm gets you far; letting go late gets you thrown into the ground.
saying.band: A soft band pulled far outthrows a stiff one pulled little.
saying.recoil: The heavy thing goes slow, the light thing fast, and both carry the same.
saying.cannon: Aim between high and flat: the middle angle flies farthest.
saying.plank: A plank that is twice as long sags eight times as much.
saying.stack: Speed climbs the cups, and speed carries you off the top.

toastText.vault: A step is coming: press V as you reach it to vault over
toastText.wall: The warped wall is coming: run up it, then hold E near the top
toastText.climb: A tall wall is coming: hold E at the wall to grab the edge and climb
toastText.lache: A bar is coming: jump, then hold E to grab it
toastText.rope: A rope is coming: jump, then hold E to catch it
toastText.pole: A pole is coming: stand at it and hold E to climb up to the bars
toastText.roll: A big drop is coming: hold X as you land to roll
toastText.jump: A gap is coming: press Space just before the edge
toastText.bounce: Trampoline ahead: press Space the moment you land on it for extra height
